sql: select series_ticker, event_ticker, count(*) mkts, round(sum(period_reward_usd),0) pool_usd, min(close_time)::text closes, max(end_date)::text prog_end, left(max(market_title),70) title from incentive_programs where incentive_type='liquidity' and (end_date is null or end_date > now()) and last_seen_at > now() - interval '2 days' and (series_ticker ilike '%MENTION%' or series_ticker ilike '%SAY%' or market_title ilike '%say%' or market_title ilike '%mention%') group by 1,2 order by 5 limit 40
